property_summary: For any caller address, the reference contract only allows the current owner to call owner-restricted functions (calls to owned() succeed for the owner and fail for non-owners); the mutant inverts the check allowing non-owners and thus will allow some non-owner caller to succeed while the reference would reject them (or vice-versa), breaking this access-control rule.
change_summary: Replace onlyOwner modifier to invert the require condition, allowing only non-owners to execute guarded functions, changing who can affect owner.
